subject: maths

items.q: Is the mean always the best average?
items.correct: No — outliers can make the median or mode more suitable.
items.misconception: Yes, the mean is always best.
items.random_wrong: The median is the most common value.
items.why: The mean is pulled by extreme values; median is the middle, mode the most frequent.

items.q: Are larger samples generally more biased?
items.correct: No — larger, well-chosen samples are usually more representative.
items.misconception: Yes, bigger samples are more biased.
items.random_wrong: A sample must be the whole population.
items.why: Bias comes from how a sample is chosen, not simply its size.
